forensic_cases = select_forensic_cases(primary_certificates, operational_ranking, secondary_certificates, CONFIG)
forensic_review_decisions = load_forensic_review_decisions(PATHS.forensic_review_input)
forensic_cases = apply_forensic_review_decisions(forensic_cases, forensic_review_decisions)
forensic_columns = [
    "selection_reasons", "review_priority", "review_classification", "review_finding", "evidence_reference",
    "reviewer", "review_date", "second_reviewer", "adjudication",
    "selected_primary_extreme", "selected_rank_displacement", "selected_operational_candidate",
    "selected_secondary_extreme", "selected_stable_reference",
    "planet_key", "planet_name_source_a", "planet_name_source_b",
    "observable", "observable_unit",
    "source_row_a", "source_row_b", "discovery_method_class_a", "discovery_method_class_b",
    "transit_evidence_a", "transit_evidence_b", "transit_concordance",
    "planet_radius_rearth_a", "planet_radius_rearth_b", "star_radius_rsun_a", "star_radius_rsun_b",
    "planet_mass_mearth_a", "planet_mass_mearth_b", "star_temperature_k_a", "star_temperature_k_b",
    "semi_major_axis_au_a", "semi_major_axis_au_b",
    "source_value_a", "source_value_b", "complete_row_width", "factorial_lower", "factorial_upper",
    "factorial_width", "factorial_inflation", "rank_a", "rank_b", "rank_displacement",
    "best_rank", "worst_rank", "top_k_status",
    "contribution_planet_radius_rearth", "contribution_star_radius_rsun",
]
forensic_table = forensic_cases.reindex(columns=forensic_columns)
forensic_report = ValidationReport("forensic_completeness")
if forensic_table.duplicated(["planet_key", "observable"]).any():
    forensic_report.add("blocking", "duplicate_forensic_case", "A planet-observable forensic case appears more than once.")
if forensic_table["selection_reasons"].isna().any() or forensic_table["selection_reasons"].astype("string").str.strip().eq("").any():
    forensic_report.add("blocking", "missing_selection_reason", "A selected forensic case has no rule-recorded reason.")
expected_primary_extremes = set(primary_certificates.loc[primary_certificates["factorial_width"].ge(CONFIG.extreme_width_threshold), "planet_key"])
observed_primary_extremes = set(forensic_table.loc[forensic_table["observable"].eq(primary_observable.name), "planet_key"])
if not expected_primary_extremes.issubset(observed_primary_extremes):
    forensic_report.add("blocking", "missing_primary_extreme", "Not every primary extreme is present in the forensic audit.")
expected_operational = set(operational_ranking.loc[operational_ranking["top_k_status"].ne("excluded"), "planet_key"])
observed_operational = set(forensic_table.loc[forensic_table["selected_operational_candidate"].fillna(False), "planet_key"])
if expected_operational != observed_operational:
    forensic_report.add("blocking", "operational_candidate_loss", "Operational candidate flags are incomplete after forensic aggregation.")
forensic_report.metrics["rows"] = len(forensic_table)
if not forensic_report.passed:
    raise RuntimeError("Forensic completeness verification failed.")

priority_zero = forensic_table["review_priority"].eq(0)
required_review_fields = [
    "review_classification", "review_finding", "evidence_reference", "reviewer",
    "review_date", "second_reviewer", "adjudication",
]
completed_fields = forensic_table[required_review_fields].astype("string").apply(lambda column: column.str.strip().ne(""))
completed_fields["review_classification"] &= ~forensic_table["review_classification"].isin(["pending", "unresolved"])
reviewer_one = forensic_table["reviewer"].astype("string").str.strip().str.casefold()
reviewer_two = forensic_table["second_reviewer"].astype("string").str.strip().str.casefold()
if CONFIG.is_solo_author:
    lead_matches = reviewer_one.str.contains(CONFIG.lead_author.casefold(), regex=False)
    sentinel_matches = reviewer_two.str.contains(SOLO_AUTHOR_SENTINEL.casefold(), regex=False)
    independent_reviewers = lead_matches & sentinel_matches
else:
    independent_reviewers = reviewer_one.ne(reviewer_two)
parsed_review_dates = pd.to_datetime(forensic_table["review_date"], errors="coerce", utc=True)
nonfuture_review_dates = parsed_review_dates.le(pd.Timestamp.now(tz="UTC"))
completed_rows = completed_fields.all(axis=1) & independent_reviewers & parsed_review_dates.notna() & nonfuture_review_dates
priority_zero_review_complete = bool((~priority_zero | completed_rows).all())
acceptable_findings = forensic_table["review_classification"].isin(["confirmed_source_difference", "confirmed_agreement", "corrected_source_error", "source_semantic_mismatch"])
if not priority_zero_review_complete:
    priority_zero_findings_status: ReviewFindingStatus = "not_assessed"
elif bool((~priority_zero | acceptable_findings).all()):
    priority_zero_findings_status = "acceptable"
else:
    priority_zero_findings_status = "correction_required"
forensic_review_report = ValidationReport("priority_zero_forensic_review")
reviewer_placeholder_matches = forensic_table[["reviewer", "second_reviewer"]].map(contains_placeholder).any(axis=1)
if reviewer_placeholder_matches.any():
    forensic_review_report.add(
        "major", "reviewer_placeholder",
        "A reviewer identity contains a placeholder term.",
        int(reviewer_placeholder_matches.sum()),
    )
if not priority_zero_review_complete:
    forensic_review_report.add(
        "major", "human_review_pending",
        "Priority-0 cases require documented self-audit review (solo-author mode) before submission-ready status.",
        int((priority_zero & ~completed_rows).sum()),
    )
elif priority_zero_findings_status == "correction_required":
    forensic_review_report.add(
        "major", "correction_required",
        "At least one completed priority-0 review identified a matching, unit, or data error requiring correction and rerun.",
        int((priority_zero & ~acceptable_findings).sum()),
    )
forensic_review_report.metrics.update(
    priority_zero_cases=int(priority_zero.sum()),
    completed_priority_zero=int((priority_zero & completed_rows).sum()),
    acceptable_priority_zero_findings=int((priority_zero & acceptable_findings).sum()),
    findings_status=priority_zero_findings_status,
    review_file_present=PATHS.forensic_review_input.is_file(),
    review_mode=author_mode_label(),
)
display(forensic_table.head(30))
display(report_table(forensic_review_report))

Publication figures¶

Figures are generated only from canonical result objects. Main panels emphasize exact widths, availability, agreement, decision stability, and rule-selected extreme cases.

In [32]:
FIGURE_PATHS: list[Path] = []
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.2))
sns.barplot(data=cohort_flow, x="n", y="stage", color=sns.color_palette()[0], ax=axes[0])
for index, value in enumerate(cohort_flow["n"]):
    axes[0].text(value, index, f" {value:,}", va="center")
axes[0].set(title="Study flow", xlabel="Rows or matched planets", ylabel="")
heat = availability_summary.reindex(columns=["a_only", "b_only", "both", "neither"], fill_value=0)
sns.heatmap(heat, annot=True, fmt="g", cmap="Blues", cbar=False, ax=axes[1])
axes[1].set(title="Observable availability", xlabel="Availability state", ylabel="")
FIGURE_PATHS.append(save_figure(fig, "figure_01_flow_and_availability"))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.2))
period_values = match_candidates["period_absolute_log_ratio"].dropna()
sns.ecdfplot(period_values, ax=axes[0])
axes[0].axvline(math.log1p(CONFIG.tier1_period_relative_tolerance), color="red", linestyle="--", label="Tier-1 tolerance")
axes[0].set(xscale="log", xlabel="Absolute period log ratio", ylabel="Empirical cumulative fraction", title="Name-candidate period consistency")
axes[0].legend()
parameter_rows = []
for variable in ("planet_radius_rearth", "star_radius_rsun", "planet_mass_mearth", "star_temperature_k"):
    a = tier1_matches[f"{variable}_a"]
    b = tier1_matches[f"{variable}_b"]
    valid = a.notna() & b.notna() & a.gt(0) & b.gt(0)
    parameter_rows.extend({"variable": variable, "log_ratio": value} for value in np.log(a[valid] / b[valid]))
sns.boxplot(data=pd.DataFrame(parameter_rows), x="variable", y="log_ratio", showfliers=False, ax=axes[1])
axes[1].axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=1)
axes[1].tick_params(axis="x", rotation=20)
axes[1].set(title="Base-parameter source differences", xlabel="", ylabel="log(A/B); outliers omitted from panel only")
FIGURE_PATHS.append(save_figure(fig, "figure_02_matching_and_parameters"))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.2))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.2))
axes[0].scatter(operational_certificates["source_value_a"], operational_certificates["source_value_b"], alpha=0.35, s=16)
finite = operational_certificates[["source_value_a", "source_value_b"]].to_numpy(float)
lo, hi = np.nanmin(finite), np.nanmax(finite)
axes[0].plot([lo, hi], [lo, hi], color="black", linestyle="--")
axes[0].set(xscale="log", yscale="log", xlabel="Source A area ratio (ppm)", ylabel="Source B area ratio (ppm)", title="Transit-only source agreement")
mean_log = 0.5 * (np.log(operational_certificates["source_value_a"]) + np.log(operational_certificates["source_value_b"]))
axes[1].scatter(mean_log, operational_certificates["signed_log_ratio"], alpha=0.35, s=16)
axes[1].axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=1)
axes[1].set(xlabel="Mean log area ratio", ylabel="log(A/B)", title="Log-scale agreement by magnitude")

top_plot = operational_ranking[operational_ranking["top_k_status"].ne("excluded")].copy()
top_plot = top_plot.sort_values("factorial_lower").tail(min(50, len(top_plot)))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, max(5, 0.22 * len(top_plot))))
y = np.arange(len(top_plot))
colors = top_plot["top_k_status"].map({"guaranteed": sns.color_palette()[2], "possible": sns.color_palette()[1]})
ax.hlines(y, top_plot["factorial_lower"], top_plot["factorial_upper"], color=colors, linewidth=1.5)
ax.scatter(top_plot["factorial_lower"], y, color=colors, s=18)
ax.scatter(top_plot["factorial_upper"], y, color=colors, marker="|", s=60)
ax.set_yticks(y, top_plot["planet_key"], fontsize=7)
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.set(xlabel="Geometric area-ratio interval (ppm)", ylabel="", title="Concordant-transit robust top-25 candidates")
FIGURE_PATHS.append(save_figure(fig, "figure_05_robust_transit_top25"))

ax.barh(extreme_plot["planet_key"], extreme_plot["factorial_width"], color=sns.color_palette()[3])
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.set(xlabel="Factorial multiplicative width", ylabel="", title="Rule-selected extreme diagnostic cases")
FIGURE_PATHS.append(save_figure(fig, "figure_07_forensic_cases"))

Canonical publication tables¶

Sample sizes use distinct names so values from different cohorts cannot overwrite one another. All manuscript numbers must be drawn from these tables or results_summary.json.

sample_rows = pd.concat([
    cohort_flow.assign(section="cohort"),
    matching_flow.assign(section="matching"),
], ignore_index=True)
sample_rows["denominator"] = np.nan
sample_rows["fraction"] = np.nan
availability_rows = availability_summary.reset_index().melt(id_vars="observable", var_name="stage", value_name="n")
availability_rows["stage"] = availability_rows["observable"] + ":" + availability_rows["stage"]
availability_rows["section"] = "availability"
availability_rows["denominator"] = len(tier1_matches)
availability_rows["fraction"] = availability_rows["n"] / len(tier1_matches)
table_01_sample_and_availability = pd.concat([
    sample_rows[["section", "stage", "n", "denominator", "fraction"]],
    availability_rows[["section", "stage", "n", "denominator", "fraction"]],
], ignore_index=True)
table_02_primary_stability = pd.DataFrame([primary_summary])
table_03_operational_top25 = operational_ranking[operational_ranking["top_k_status"].ne("excluded")][[
    "planet_key", "planet_name_source_a", "planet_name_source_b", "transit_concordance",

]].copy()

if int(table_02_primary_stability.loc[0, "n_primary"]) != len(primary_certificates):
    raise RuntimeError("Primary table sample size is inconsistent.")
if len(table_03_operational_top25) != int(ranking_summary["robust_candidate_pool"]):

quality_gates = {
    "generator_script_available": input_manifest["code_assets"]["generator"] is not None,
    "raw_schema_a": raw_report_a.passed,
    "raw_schema_b": raw_report_b.passed,
    "canonical_a": canonical_report_a.passed,
    "canonical_b": canonical_report_b.passed,
    "tier1_minimum": len(tier1_matches) >= CONFIG.minimum_tier1_matches,
    "primary_minimum": len(primary_cohort) >= CONFIG.minimum_primary_cohort,
    "operational_minimum": len(operational_cohort) >= CONFIG.minimum_operational_cohort,
    "operational_all_concordant_transits": operational_cohort["transit_concordance"].eq("both_transit").all(),
    "primary_certificates_fully_verified": primary_verification.passed and primary_verification.metrics["eligible_rows"] == len(primary_certificates),
    "operational_certificates_fully_verified": operational_verification.passed,
    "robust_ranking_verified": ranking_verification.passed,
    "primary_table_count_consistent": int(table_02_primary_stability.loc[0, "n_primary"]) == len(primary_certificates),
    "operational_table_count_consistent": len(table_03_operational_top25) == int(ranking_summary["robust_candidate_pool"]),
    "physics_reference_tests": physics_reference_report.passed,
    "ranking_reference_tests": ranking_reference_report.passed,
    "data_contract_reference_tests": contract_reference_report.passed,
    "randomized_bound_property_tests": bound_property_report.passed,
    "randomized_ranking_property_tests": ranking_property_report.passed,
    "secondary_certificates_fully_verified": all(report.passed for report in secondary_reports),
    "threshold_partitions_consistent": bool(np.allclose(threshold_sensitivity["fraction_at_or_below"] + threshold_sensitivity["fraction_above"], 1.0)),
    "threshold_counts_consistent": bool((threshold_sensitivity["count_at_or_below"] + threshold_sensitivity["count_above"]).eq(len(primary_certificates)).all()),
    "forensic_case_selection_complete": forensic_report.passed,
    "detection_mapping_complete": not detection_mapping_audit[["discovery_method_class", "transit_evidence"]].isna().any().any(),
    "operational_exclusion_count_consistent": len(operational_exclusion_audit) == len(primary_cohort) - len(operational_cohort),
    "no_blocking_validation_issues": not any(report.blocking_count for report in all_reports),
}

Limitations and prohibited interpretations¶

  1. Two derivative source artifacts do not span all epistemic or measurement uncertainty.
  2. Coordinate-wise hybrid vertices need not correspond to a published complete parameter set.
  3. Shared literature means the sources are not independent replications.
  4. Complete-case cohorts are selected toward better-characterized systems.
  5. The geometric area ratio is not an observed transit depth or full target-priority metric.
  6. Mass-dependent results are secondary because mass semantics may differ.
  7. Host resampling measures composition sensitivity, not uncertainty about the frozen estimand.
  8. Extreme cases require source-provenance interpretation and are not automatically errors.
  9. The analysis measures reproducibility under substitution, not truth, causality, or habitability.
  10. Observed discrepancies confound catalog curation decisions with the temporal information-epoch difference between sources (Source A extends to ~February 2018; Source B is frozen in March 2026); disentangling these two effects requires access to same-epoch catalog versions.
  11. Of the 444 selected forensic cases, only all 113 priority-0 cases received documented self-audit review; the remaining 331 lower-priority cases have not been manually reviewed and their classification is provisional.

Reproducible conclusion contract¶

All manuscript numbers must be copied from results_summary.json or the four canonical tables, with the same denominators, population labels, and rounding policy. A definitive execution requires a clean kernel and all cells run once in notebook order.

COMPUTATIONAL CERTIFICATION: PASS certifies the implemented mathematics, controlled cohort construction, exhaustive finite-vertex verification, randomized property tests, robust-ranking logic, deterministic exports, generator availability, and artifact hashes. READINESS STATUS: COMPUTATIONALLY READY; SOLO-AUTHOR SELF-AUDIT COMPLETE; FINAL PACKAGE AUDIT COMPLETE; EXTERNAL REPRODUCTION PENDING reflects complete source provenance, documented self-audit review of every priority-0 forensic case with no unresolved correction-required finding, a clean-environment reproduction using the same protocol and frozen inputs, certified by the lead author as a solo-author self-audit, and a completed final package audit covering the raw-input copies, corrections ledger, supplement exports, and table S1. External independent reproduction remains pending.

These statuses do not establish that either source is correct, do not quantify total astrophysical uncertainty, do not guarantee peer-review acceptance, and do not replace scientific judgment about provenance, population selection, or interpretation.

The clean-environment self-reproduction was performed by the lead author (Khaled Tarchi) using a separate Python environment with identical frozen inputs. This constitutes self-reproduction, not independent reproduction; independent reproduction requires verification by an unaffiliated party.
